name: rea-for-claude
description: REA's 207 reverse-engineering tools as a one-click Claude Desktop extension. Bundles rea-agents 6.7.0; the engines (JDK 21, Ghidra 12.1.4, jadx) install themselves into ~/.rea-engines on first use, or point it at your own installs from the settings panel.
long_description: Runs the REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) MCP server inside Claude Desktop using the app's built-in Node runtime, so no Node.js install is required. On first start the bundled installer fetches the analysis engines for this OS and CPU into ~/.rea-engines in the background (JDK 21 when none is usable, Ghidra 12.1.4 with SHA-256 verification, jadx-headless-mcp 0.7.1); the settings panel lets you point at your own Ghidra / jadx / Kuna / IDA installs instead. Blank settings are ignored. Sessions linked to this computer can use the tools from claude.ai on the web and your phone.
